title: Implement local index-root parity for item/task list operations
description: Add local resolver support for key list-by-account-and-time roots used by CLI list/last flows so fallback paths are no longer required in smoke tests.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Implemented strict local index-root proof for canonical CLI item/task flows. scripts/smoke-local-cli.sh now runs real items list and tasks last commands without fallback, and asserts /debug/upstream-requests is empty. Backend tests cover local item/task legacy index aliases with a failing upstream client so accidental forwarding fails the test. Clean proof harness verification passed from a reset smoke database.
